newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: YUGO Q1 EXPORTS RISE TO EU SATISFACTORY, MINISTER.
newsitem.headline: YUGO Q1 EXPORTS RISE TO EU SATISFACTORY, MINISTER.

text.p: The growth in Yugoslav exports to the European Union in January-March is satisfactory and the EU trade benefits are seen as a possibility to stimulate exports further, a senior government official said Friday.
"It is still below our set targets for this year, but we expect the real dynamic of exports to be shown in the second half of the year," said the Federal Trade Minister Borislav Vukovic.
In the first three months this year, exports to the EU increased 57.8 percent to $166.1 million from $105.3 million over the same period in 1996.
Imports in the same period stood at $363 million, up 11.6 percent against $325 million in the first quarter last year. -- Gordana Kukic, Belgrade Newsroom +381 11 222 4254
